purpose: Define immutable, constitutional, and DAO-aligned audit trail requirements for all municipal systems within the Munisible Task Force.

immutability.description: Audit trails must be append-only, tamper-proof, and cryptographically anchored.
rules: No deletion of entries under any circumstances.
No overwriting or modification of existing entries.
All entries must include cryptographic hash chaining.

timestamp_integrity.description: All audit entries must include accurate, kernel-verified timestamps.
rules: Timestamps must be generated by the Identity Kernel time authority.
Out-of-sequence timestamps must trigger a telemetry anomaly alert.
Missing timestamps automatically escalate to Civic Integrity Division.

actor_verification.description: Every audit entry must include verified actor identity and authority classification.
rules: Actor ID must be validated through the Identity Kernel.
Authority level must be included and cross-checked.
Unauthorized actors attempting to log entries must trigger alerts.

event_structure.description: Audit entries must follow a standardized, machine-readable structure.

chain_of_custody.description: All audit data must maintain a verifiable chain of custody.
rules: Every transfer or access event must be logged.
Custody changes must include actor identity and justification.
Unauthorized access attempts must be recorded as critical events.

public_transparency.description: Audit trails must support public-facing transparency dashboards.
rules: Non-sensitive integrity metrics must be published automatically.
Documentation anomalies must be publicly flagged.
Municipal performance indicators must sync to dashboards.

actions: Escalation to Ethics Division for rights-impact assessment

kernel_dependencies.identity_kernel: Required for actor verification and timestamp authority.
kernel_dependencies.telemetry_kernel: Required for anomaly detection and integrity scoring.
